tool.name: reverse_ip_discovery
tool.description:
Discover domains co-hosted on the target's IP(s) via reverse-IP lookup APIs.
Given an IP address — or a domain that resolves to one — query free reverse-IP databases (HackerTarget no-key, ViewDNS key-gated) to find other domains sharing the host. Shared hosting is a real-world pivot vector: a vulnerable neighbour on the same physical/virtual host can be a launchpad onto the in-scope target via weak tenant isolation, shared services, or container/VM escape paths.
Behaviour: - HackerTarget is queried unconditionally (free, no key, ~50/day rate limit per source IP). - ViewDNS is queried when `STRIX_VIEWDNS_KEY` is set; silently skipped otherwise. - Domain targets are resolved via DNS first; up to 5 IPs are queried. - Private/loopback/link-local IPs are filtered out before the API call (don't leak internal IPs to a third-party service). - Per-IP cap of 250 results to bound payload size against shared-hosting providers with thousands of co-tenants (CDN edge IPs, etc.). - Emits an info-severity finding when an IP has >= 5 co-tenants — the signal that the target is on shared hosting and the pivot surface is broader than the apex.
Categories: `info_disclosure`. CWE: `CWE-200`.

parameter.name: target
parameter.description: An IPv4/IPv6 address, or a domain (which will be resolved to its A records first).

parameter.name: providers
parameter.description: Comma-separated subset of {hackertarget, viewdns}. Default: all (key-gated providers fall back gracefully when the key isn't set).

returns.description: {success, target, target_type, ips_queried, providers_queried, per_ip_results: [{ip, providers: [{provider, ip, success, domains, error?}, ...]}, ...], merged_domains, merged_count}.
